01

Below-fold CAPTCHA code runs on first load

The homepage’s below-fold reCAPTCHA consumes about 1.28 seconds of CPU in a mobile lab run, alongside a 47/53 performance benchmark.

  • Test loading the CAPTCHA only as the form is approached or used, keeping required validation before submission.
  • Retest #text_block-21-45 text LCP and total blocking time; preserve forms, chat, tracking and critical styles.
02

Clear-aligner links lead to fixed braces

Thirteen removable-aligner-context links lead to the fixed clear-braces service instead of the live Invisalign page.

  • Point the mapped links to /services/invisalign/; remove the redundant shared link on that destination page itself.
  • Keep both treatment pages and correctly labeled fixed-braces links; do not add a redirect.

03

Business schema gives conflicting weekday hours

The homepage LocalBusiness markup closes Tuesday and Thursday at 04:00 and adds midnight closed records on days the office is open.

  • Change Tuesday/Thursday closes from 04:00 to 16:00; retain Monday/Wednesday 08:00–17:00 and Tuesday/Thursday 07:30–16:00.
  • Remove the conflicting Mon/Tue/Thu 00:00–00:00 entries, preserving valid business and six Service graphs.
04

Two obsolete sitemap submissions still show errors

Two retired taxonomy feeds return 404 while remaining submitted in Search Console; the current sitemap index works.

  • Remove only /post_tag-sitemap1.xml and /category-sitemap1.xml submissions from Search Console.
  • Keep /sitemaps.xml and the working post feed; do not restore the retired feeds or redirect service pages.

Fix order

Reduce avoidable first-load processing, correct the mapped treatment links and hours, then retire old sitemap submissions.

  • Website: safe CAPTCHA initialization, exact contextual hrefs and LocalBusiness hours only.
  • SEO: two obsolete submission removals; retain current feeds and the existing Ericka blog task.

Preserve the orthodontic scope, native/tracked phones and existing blog task. Lab processing and local layout shifts are not field results; no service-page redirects are proposed.
